blocks.text: The daily grind of eDiscovery management

Your day involves constant context switching. You move from RelativityOne to Outlook, then to a Jira ticket, and finally to a Python script. This fragmentation makes it difficult to maintain deep focus. Administrative tasks often consume the time you should spend on data review or QC processes.
How an AI assistant for eDiscovery specialists helps

Lazur acts as a bridge between your intent and your Mac interface. When you need to find a specific setting in a web-based portal, you ask Lazur where it is. It draws a circle around the element. If you need to draft a status update for a client, you dictate the text directly into your browser or email client.

You likely use a mix of browser-based tools and local applications. Whether you are using Chrome to access a cloud platform or a terminal to manage a local collection script, Lazur works across your entire screen. It does not require specific app integration.

blocks.text: As a legal professional, you must ensure all interactions with AI tools comply with your firm's data privacy policies. Never share sensitive client or patient data with any AI service. Lazur processes data locally and does not store your screen content, but always follow your employer's rules regarding protected information.
blocks.title: Data Privacy and Compliance

blocks.text: Many specialists struggle with file location and email management. When you spend hours searching for the right document or responding to internal queries, your billable time suffers. Lazur helps by managing your reminders and calendar, allowing you to focus on the technical review.
When to use voice for documentation

Dictation is a powerful tool for drafting. When you need to record a quick note about a document review, use the fn key. It captures your thoughts and turns them into clean, formatted text. This is faster than typing and helps you keep your eyes on the review platform.

Start by installing Lazur on your Mac. Open the app and begin with simple commands. Ask for the time, set a timer for a review session, or add a task to your reminders. As you get comfortable, use the screen-aware features to find buttons in your primary eDiscovery software.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with RelativityOne or other cloud platforms?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur works with any application on your Mac, including web browsers like Chrome or Safari. It does not need to integrate with the platform itself.

faq.question: Is my data safe when using Lazur?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen and hears your voice when you hold the activation keys. No data is stored, and your content is never used to train AI models.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my eDiscovery software for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate applications. It guides you, points at elements, and answers your questions so you can perform the work yourself.

faq.question: Does Lazur work on Windows?
faq.answer: Lazur is currently available for macOS only. A Windows version is planned but not yet available.
